source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1036 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1036 was established by Ordinance No. 31631, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 9, 2020. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1036 is established on property generally located along the north line of Ridge Center Drive west of Cedar Ridge Drive. The size of PD 1036 is approximately 22 acres. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 1036A: development plan. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a multifamily development with buildings greater than 36 feet in height, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 1036A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.
(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text: SEC. 51P-1036.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED. The only main uses permitted in this district are those main uses permitted in the MF-2(A) Multifamily District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MF-2(A) Multifamily District as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the MF-2(A) Multifamily District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MF-2(A) Multifamily District is subject to DIR in this district, etc. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MF-2(A) Multifamily District apply.

(b) Height.

(1) Except as provided in this subsection, maximum structure height is 36 feet.

(2) Maximum structure height is 51 feet for a multifamily project complying with Sections 51P-1036.113 and 51P.1036.114. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text: SEC. 51P-1036.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS. See Article VI. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Mixed Income Housing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.113. MIXED INCOME HOUSING.

A multifamily project qualifies for the increased structure height in Section 51P- 1036.108(b)(2) if a minimum of five percent of the total number of units are provided at income band 2 and in compliance with Division 51A-4.1100. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Open Space
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.114. OPEN SPACE.

To receive the increase in structure height in Section 51P-1036.108(b)(2), open space must include the following:

(1) Minimum of two play areas in the locations shown on the development plan.

(2) Security lighting on each open space area in the locations shown on the development plan.

(3) Minimum of three trash receptacles.

(4) Minimum of two pavilions in the locations shown on the development plan. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 31631)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1036.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 31631)
